chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Barqī, from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymūn and Ḥusayn ibn Zurārah, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who manipulates with his hand until he ejaculates. He said: “There is no fixed penalty in it, and that has not reached any prescribed measure.”

So the proper understanding of this report is that it has not reached a fixed, prescribed punishment from which deviation is not permitted, because when the ruling involves taʿzīr, that is left to the Imam, who enacts it according to what he deems appropriate in the circumstance.

key_terms.التَّعْزِيرُ: discretionary disciplinary punishment not fixed as hadd
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the authority who determines the discretionary punishment
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no fixed penal liability in it in this context
key_terms.مُوَظَّفًا: prescribed and fixed as a determined penalty
key_terms.يَعْبَثُ: to manipulate or play with, here referring to manual stimulation

ai.seo_question: Does this hadith assign a fixed punishment for masturbation, or is it left to discretionary taʿzīr?
ai.summary: This report addresses the legal ruling concerning self-stimulation resulting in ejaculation. It indicates that there is no fixed hadd punishment for it; rather, if disciplinary punishment applies, it falls under taʿzīr and is left to the discretion of the Imam according to the circumstances.
